description: The Survival Envelope: High-fidelity system resilience scan mapping Victorian water survival.
methodology: Resilience Mapping: Implemented a high-fidelity scatter-trajectory idiom plotting 'Reservoir Health' (Average Storage %) against 'Engineering Injection' (Desalination Orders). System Trajectory: Connected temporal data points (2012-2025) to visualize the state's physical movement across stress quadrants. Quadrant Modeling: Modeled four distinct operational zones: Safe Zone, Critical Stress, Engineered Survival, and Artificial Recharge. Forensic HUD: Integrated a real-time status indicator (Critical vs Recovery) based on storage thresholds. Aesthetic: Industrial tech-scan theme with 'Magma' temporal encoding.
citation: Melbourne Water. (2026). Historical Reservoir Levels & Desalination Orders. Spatially and temporally harmonized for resilience scanning by D. Sharma (2026).
